Hi Ari / Jasmine —

Thanks for flagging — I'm on this. Quick summary of what I found: the calendar event was generated by our automated demo-scheduler address (redwood-demo+noreply@redwood.ai) and the meeting token is expiring for guests when the invite is forwarded or when the recipient's calendar proxy strips the token. That matches the 404 screenshot.

Proposed fix (fastest path):
- Create a new calendar event using a Zoom meeting link (we'll host).
- Make Ben the organizer on the new invite (so if anything needs reissuing we can reprovision from an account that isn't a noreply).
- Include Samira directly in the event so she can validate guest join before the call.
- Send updated invite + Zoom link to FinVista and confirm acceptance.

Zoom details (temporary meeting):
https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=Tr1v3lY
Passcode: FVJoin23

I'll create the event and send it in ~5 minutes. Jasmine — leaving the deck attached and will reference during the call. Ben — flag me if you'd rather we keep the hosted Meet link and instead rotate tokens.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
